messages:
kevin_ops: follow-up from today's all-hands infra Q&A about capacity hedging and autoscale. quick thanks and a couple of clarifications :wave:
kevin_ops: 1) what does 'reserve inventory' actually lock (hardware vs slot)? 2) how do per-tenant warm pools work with committed reservations?

sara_infra: short: reserve inventory locks allocation intent and a warm-pool seat for the chosen region until the commit window starts. It doesn't move physical racks until shipment/fulfillment, but it guarantees allocation priority. Per-tenant warm pools = reserved min instances that are tagged to the tenant and kept warm in the region.

nate_sre: operational note: warm pools are per-AZ and per-tenant where reserved. Default min_warm is low (1-3) but scales with traffic. If warm pools exhausted, autoscaler uses preemptible local capacity then model-variant fallback before cross-region routing to protect latency.

olivia_product: can we show an "inventory hold" badge in the reservation UI and an opt-in checkbox for cross-region backfill? AE wants clear copy for customers.

sara_infra: yes. UI: badge + tooltip. Backfill is opt-in and clearly warns about increased RTT; we prefer fallback model variants for latency-sensitive workloads. Billing: burst charges billed where compute runs; cross-region backfill shows estimated cost in the reservation flow.

opsbot: [deploy-bot] autoscaler-canary scheduled: 2026-12-10T02:00Z -> target 10% Dedicated clusters. Monitors: autoscale_events, p99_latency, cold_start_rate.

nate_sre: sample policy teams can paste into local simulator: ```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_warm_instances: 2
  reserved_warm_tag: tenant:true
  burst_local_pct: 20
  cold_start_grace_ms: 150
```

kevin_ops: last Q: will commits change pricing or SLAs?

sara_infra: committed pricing stays the same. Commits get allocation priority and warm-pool reservation; SLA/penalties unchanged. We'll publish a one-pager + short FAQ by Friday (internal + public versions).

maya_ceo: thanks everyone. infra/product please post the FAQ here when ready so we can lock comms. :thumbsup:
